title: Azpiazu's arrival and the friendship with Machin
summary: He says he came on the same boat as Azpiazu and mentions his close friend Antonio Machin, linking to his later trumpet playing.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Right. So -- but was Luckey Roberts playing -- because Aspersoo (phonetic) had --
In fact, I came together with him on the same boat.
Uh-huh. Did you -- did you hear the show that he played at Paramount and around?

Yeah, I remember it was -- the front of it was a shinga (phonetic). They just pass away, man, and in Spain, [Antonio] MACHIN, the pay machine (phonetic) was a close friend of mine. So that's how I came to be a trumpet player, after I (inaudible). Later on I became a trumpet player.
